title: Neurovisceral model of social anxiety disorder: An integrative review
title_zh: 社会焦虑障碍的神经内脏模型：一项综合综述
abstract: Social anxiety involves persistent fear of negative evaluation that causes significant distress or avoidance in social situations and, when lasting at least six months with meaningful impairment across life domains, meets diagnostic criteria for social anxiety disorder (SAD). The origins and maintenance of SAD have been described by disparate models as dysregulation of central and peripheral networks involved in emotion regulation and threat appraisal. However, studies integrating central and peripheral levels of analysis remain scarce and lack integration, leaving our understanding of the neurobiology of SAD fragmented. Here we review these models and extant evidence. This review proposes an integrated neurovisceral model in which SAD reflects context-sensitive dysregulation among cortical regulation, limbic threat signaling, insular interoception, vagal and autonomic regulation, cardiac flexibility, HPA-axis output, and behavior. Genetic liability and behavioral inhibition are conceptualized as probabilistic influences on threat sensitivity and regulatory capacity. While environmental experience, developmental timing, sex-related factors, and stress sensitization shape the calibration of these systems. The model predicts heterogeneity along activation threshold, response magnitude, recovery, and central-peripheral coordination, which may give rise to acute hyperreactive, persistent sensitized/inflexible, and compromised/blunted SAD configurations. The model also generates testable predictions for longitudinal, multimodal research, and supports profile-sensitive approaches to assessment and treatment.
abstract_zh: 社会焦虑涉及对负面评价的持续恐惧，导致在社交情境中产生显著痛苦或回避，并且当持续至少六个月且在生活各领域产生实质性功能障碍时，符合社会焦虑障碍（SAD）的诊断标准。SAD 的起源和维持已被不同模型描述为涉及情绪调节和威胁评估的中枢与外周网络的失调。然而，整合中枢与外周层面的研究仍然稀缺且缺乏整合，导致我们对 SAD 神经生物学的理解呈碎片化。本文综述了这些模型和现有证据，并提出了一个整合的神经内脏模型，认为 SAD 反映了皮层调节、边缘系统威胁信号、岛叶内感知、迷走神经与自主调节、心脏灵活性、HPA 轴输出以及行为之间的情境敏感失调。遗传易感性和行为抑制被概念化为对威胁敏感性和调节能力的概率性影响，而环境经验、发育时机、性别相关因素和压力敏化则塑造了这些系统的校准。该模型预测了激活阈值、反应幅度、恢复以及中枢-外周协调方面的异质性，可能导致急性过度反应、持续敏化/不灵活以及受损/减弱的 SAD 结构。该模型还为纵向、多模态研究提供了可检验的预测，并支持针对性评估和治疗的配置敏感方法。
